language.label: Language
language.hint: Pluck uses your iPhone's language. Change it in iOS Settings, Pluck, Language.

failed.title: That did not go through
failed.body: Check the connection, then try again.

movedMany.archived: {count, plural, one {Gone. Well, archived.} other {# items. Gone. Well, archived.}}
movedMany.later: {count, plural, one {Kept for later.} other {# items. Kept for later.}}
movedMany.inbox: {count, plural, one {Back in the Inbox.} other {# items. Back in the Inbox.}}

usage.title: Help make Pluck better<accent>?</accent>
usage.body: Share which screens you use, tied to your account, so we fix what gets in the way. No ads. No selling. Crash reports go either way, without your name on them.

items.moveFailed: That did not go through. Nothing moved.

inbox.title: Nothing to triage.
inbox.body: Tap Share in any app, then Pluck. It lands here.

later.title: Nothing for later.
later.body: Swipe an item right in the Inbox and it waits here.

lists.sharedA11y: {name}, shared by {owner}, {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}

empty.title: No lists yet.
empty.body: Make one on the web, or ask your AI to build one from what you plucked.

start.title: Find it again.
start.body: Titles, notes, tags, lists and the words on the page.

error.title: Search didn't answer.
error.body: Check the connection, then try again.

none.title: Nothing plucked matches that.
none.body: Try fewer words, or another filter.

search.byMeaning: Want it by meaning? Ask your AI.

note.title: Note
note.placeholder: Why you kept it, or what to do with it.
note.hint: Only you see it. Search finds it.

welcome.title:
You're in.
Now pluck something.
welcome.lede: You never need to open this app to pluck. It lives in Share, in every app.
welcome.tryHint: Opens a sample page in Safari. Share it to Pluck.

tags.title: Tags
tags.deleteBody: It comes off {count, plural, one {the # item} other {# items}}. The items stay.

empty.title: No tags yet.
empty.body: Tag something from its long press, or the reader's Tags.

empty.title: Nothing on this list yet.
empty.body: Tap Add to put plucks on it, or ask your AI to fill it.

list.takenOut: {count, plural, one {# Item} other {# Items}} taken out. Still in your library.

shared.copied: Plucked. Your own copy is in Lists.
shared.leaveBody: It comes off your Lists. They can share it with you again.
shared.byNamed: Shared with you by {name} (@{handle}) · see only
shared.by: Shared with you by @{handle} · see only

notShared.title: Not shared with you.
notShared.body: Either this List no longer exists, or it isn't shared with {email}. If someone sent you the link, ask them to share it with that address.
notShared.bodyNoEmail: Either this List no longer exists, or it isn't shared with the email you signed in with. If someone sent you the link, ask them to share it with that address.

shared.pluckHint: Copies it into your own Pluck

signin.stale: That link was from an earlier try. Open the newest email, or send a new link.
signin.notServer: That isn't a server address. It starts with https://.
signin.badKey: That key did not work on this server.
signin.title:
One link.
No password<accent>.</accent>
signin.lede: Type your email and we send a link. It signs you in, or starts your library if you are new.
signin.key: API key, if you use one
signin.noKey: No key? Leave it empty and we email you a link from that server.

preview.a11y: The email: Here is your link. Tap it to sign in. It works once, for 10 minutes.
preview.subject: Your link to Pluck
preview.title: Here is your link.
preview.body: Tap it to sign in. It works once, for 10 minutes. No password to remember, ever.

handle.title: Handle
handle.invalid: 3 to 24 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
handle.hint: It goes in the link to every List you make public.
handle.moveNone: No public Lists yet, so no links change. Once saved, it can change again in a month.
handle.move: {count, plural, one {Your public List moves} other {Your # public Lists move}} to {host}/@{handle}/… and links to the old address stop working. Lists shared with people by email are not affected. Once saved, it can change again in a month.

share.title: Share

sees.me: Only you can see this List.
sees.people: The people here see the titles, sites, covers and your notes on this List, never your tags, ticks or the pages Pluck kept. Only you change it.
sees.anyone: Public: anyone who has this link can open it, without signing in, and it can turn up in search. They see the titles, sites, covers and your notes on this List, never your tags, ticks or the pages Pluck kept. Make it private again any time; the link stops working at once.

share.stopManyTitle: Stop sharing with {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}?
share.stopManyBody: They can no longer see it. Share again any time.
share.anyoneBody: It gets a public page at your handle. Never the tags, ticks or pages Pluck kept. Make it private again any time.
share.sharedWith: Shared with {email}. They get an email with a link.
share.stopOneBody: They can no longer see it.

pick.noTagsBody: Type one above. Your AI can tag things too.
pick.noListsBody: Type a name above to start one, or ask your AI to build one.
pick.noListsManyBody: Type a name above to start one.
pick.nothing: Nothing in the Inbox or Later.
pick.nothingBody: Pluck something first. It shows up here.

item.didntLoadBody: It may be gone, or the connection is. Try again in a bit.
item.notKeptBody: It opens when you are back online. On Wi-Fi, Pluck keeps your newest items here for reading offline.
item.pending: Plucking the page. It shows here in a moment.
item.failedFile: The file is kept. Its words weren't.
item.failedPage: Some pages keep their words to themselves. The link is kept, and the original still opens.
item.titleHint: Leave the title empty and the first line is the title. Saves as you type.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.nameBody: Shown on Lists you make public.
settings.signOutBody: Plucks queued on this phone stay here until you sign in again.
settings.accountFootnote: Your name and handle show on Lists you make public, and nowhere else.
settings.connectorCopied: Copied. Paste it into your AI.
settings.disconnectBody: It stops reading and plucking straight away. Connect it again any time.
settings.toolsNeedAccount: Your connected AI tools show here once you sign in again with an email link.
settings.toolsNone: No AI tool connected yet. Add the address once in your AI tool; it works on every device you use it on.
settings.toolsHint: Add the address once in your AI tool. It works on every device you use it on.
settings.newAddressBody: The old one stops working at once. Update anything that forwards to it.
settings.emailInFootnote: Forward a newsletter here. It lands in the Inbox as a Read item.
settings.moveAfterTitle: Untouched items move to the Archive after
settings.expirySaved: Untouched for {count} days goes to the Archive. Nothing is deleted.
settings.weeklyOn: The weekly email comes on {day, select, 0 {Sundays} 1 {Mondays} 2 {Tuesdays} 3 {Wednesdays} 4 {Thursdays} 5 {Fridays} other {Saturdays}}.
settings.expiryFootnote: Untouched items move to the Archive, nothing is deleted. The weekly email: what moves soon, what is due, and things you plucked and forgot.
settings.exportingBody: A zip of everything is on its way to {email}. The link arrives in a minute or two.
settings.exportingBodyNoEmail: A zip of everything is on its way to your email. The link arrives in a minute or two.
settings.offlineValue: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · {mb} MB
settings.clearBody: Your library stays on the server. The app downloads it again as you use it.
settings.keepFootnote: On Wi-Fi, Pluck keeps the text of your newest {count} items in Inbox, Later and Lists on this iPhone, so you can read them with no connection. Text only, no pictures.
settings.serverBody: This phone uses {host}. To use another server, sign out, then choose "Use your own server".
settings.iconFootnote: Just the icon. The app itself follows your phone.
settings.usageFootnote: Which screens you use, tied to your account. Never what you pluck. Crash reports go either way, without your name.
settings.tipBody: In any app, tap Share, scroll the app row to More, and drag Pluck to the front.
settings.deleteBody: Every item, tag, note and list, for good. Export first if you want a copy.
